findings.desc: The validate execution lock is released before story-scoped validation evidence is decorated and persisted. In the configured/fallback path, withValidationExecutionLock wraps only executeValidationPlan at packages/main/src/handlers/verifier.ts:820-825, then persistStoryValidationEvidence runs after release at packages/main/src/handlers/verifier.ts:847. In the validate.ts path, the lock wraps only runValidationCommand at packages/main/src/handlers/verifier.ts:895-900, while JSON/pollution evidence writes happen after release at packages/main/src/handlers/verifier.ts:927, packages/main/src/handlers/verifier.ts:941, and packages/main/src/handlers/verifier.ts:962. persistStoryValidationEvidence writes test-evidence.json at packages/main/src/handlers/verifier.ts:605-621. A second validate started immediately after the first command exits can acquire the lock and write newer evidence while the first process is still decorating/persisting, allowing the older result to clobber the newer test-evidence snapshot. The no-validator branch also writes evidence without using the lock at packages/main/src/handlers/verifier.ts:800. Keep the lock held through decorateStoryVerification and persistStoryValidationEvidence for all story-scoped validate evidence writes, while leaving reviewer/delivery metadata outside the lock.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by holding withValidationExecutionLock through command execution, story result decoration, and persistStoryValidationEvidence for story-scoped non-focus validate evidence writes in no-validator, configured/fallback, validate.ts pollution, parsed JSON, and wrapped JSON paths. Verified with npm --prefix packages/main run build, validate-execution-lock smoke (9 assertions including post-command persistence race), and validate-command-timeout smoke (18 assertions).
